content:
grace: hitting odd duplicate-embed behavior from the Next starter when using SSG/ISR + a revalidate endpoint. first request during revalidation triggers the indexer and sometimes the background revalidate job does too, resulting in two embeddings for the same page id.

devin: can you paste the exact flow? is this only ISR (revalidate) or also on manual reindex?

grace: repro: deploy starter to Vercel with ISR revalidate=60, visit `/posts/slug` cold, the edge route triggers indexing via `fetch('/api/reindex?source=ssg')` and the background worker also picks up the same payload. repro is deterministic on our staging once per deploy. log: 
```
2026-09-01T07:12:01.002Z INFO edge handler started revalidate id=post-99
2026-09-01T07:12:01.003Z INFO edge handler called indexer for id=post-99
2026-09-01T07:12:01.004Z INFO background worker polled job id=post-99
2026-09-01T07:12:01.005Z INFO backend embed accepted for id=post-99
2026-09-01T07:12:01.006Z INFO backend embed accepted for id=post-99 (duplicate)
```

grace: starter code currently just does `await client.embeddings.create({ input: html })` with no idempotency key.

tony: two causes: (A) duplicated triggering (edge + worker) and (B) no deterministic idempotency on the request. server-side dedupe would help but we should ship a starter-level mitigation.

keiko: quick starter fix: compute `x-redwood-idempotency` from `sha256(sourceUrl + contentVersion)` and attach it to the embed call. That way both invocations collide server-side. Provide a tiny helper `computeEmbedKey(url, version)` in the starter.

frank: small nuance: if ISR revalidate originates from multiple concurrent visitors the edge may spawn multiple revalidate calls; deterministic key prevents duplicates but developer intent to reindex should be expressed via `version` to force new id when content changed. Document that.

devin: can we also debounce at the job-queue level (lock per-key) to avoid background-worker duplicates? We'll need to add a short TTL lock in the queue shard. filing a backend ticket.

grace: I'll add the helper to the starter and update the `/api/reindex` to use `key = computeEmbedKey(url, gitSha || now)` and set header `x-redwood-idempotency`.

keiko: for the sample LangChain connector docs, show how to pass that key as `idempotencyKey` when indexing documents produced by `getStaticProps`. Also add a note to include content version.

frank: CI suggestion: add an integration test that simulates edge revalidate + background worker calling reindex concurrently against a mock embed service and assert backend sees only one embed per key.

ci-bot: ci/integration-revalidate job queued -> will run after PR.

grace: timeline: I'll open starter PR with helper + docs today, devin will open backend lock ticket (#4510) and keiko will update LangChain sample. Once CI passes we'll mark resolved. :rocket:
